scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SHELL,OBRAS,CADASTROS,REMESSAS,ORDENS -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green,blue "npm start" "npm run start:mfe:obras" "npm run start:mfe:cadastros" "npm run start:mfe:remessas" "npm run start:mfe:ordens-compra"
scripts.build:mfes: npm run build:mfe:obras && npm run build:mfe:cadastros && npm run build:mfe:remessas && npm run build:mfe:ordens-compra
scripts.sync:mfes: npm run sync:mfe:obras && npm run sync:mfe:cadastros && npm run sync:mfe:remessas && npm run sync:mfe:ordens-compra
scripts.sync:mfe:obras: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const source='../mfe-daruix-obras/dist/mfe-daruix-obras';const target='public/remotes/obras';if(!fs.existsSync(source))throw new Error('Build do MFE nao encontrado: '+source);fs.rmSync(target,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync(target,{recursive:true});fs.cpSync(source,target,{recursive:true});"
scripts.sync:mfe:cadastros: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const source='../mfe-daruix-cadastros/dist/mfe-daruix-cadastros';const target='public/remotes/cadastros';if(!fs.existsSync(source))throw new Error('Build do MFE nao encontrado: '+source);fs.rmSync(target,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync(target,{recursive:true});fs.cpSync(source,target,{recursive:true});"
scripts.sync:mfe:remessas: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const source='../daruix-mfe-remessas/dist/daruix-mfe-remessas';const target='public/remotes/remessas';if(!fs.existsSync(source))throw new Error('Build do MFE nao encontrado: '+source);fs.rmSync(target,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync(target,{recursive:true});fs.cpSync(source,target,{recursive:true});"
scripts.sync:mfe:ordens-compra: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const source='../mfe-daruix-ordens-compra/dist/mfe-daruix-ordens-compra';const target='public/remotes/ordens-compra';if(!fs.existsSync(source))throw new Error('Build do MFE nao encontrado: '+source);fs.rmSync(target,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync(target,{recursive:true});fs.cpSync(source,target,{recursive:true});"
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:mobile && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && npx cap run android --no-sync
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:aab: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.resources: npx capacitor-assets generate && npx cap sync android
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run desktop:build && npm --prefix desktop run pack
scripts.desktop:dist:win: npm run desktop:build && npm --prefix desktop run dist:win
scripts.desktop:dist:linux: npm run desktop:build && npm --prefix desktop run dist:linux
scripts.desktop:dist:mac: npm run desktop:build && npm --prefix desktop run dist:mac
scripts.build:bundled: npm run build:mfes && npm run sync:mfes && ng build --configuration=production
